issues.title: The handshake leaks a crackable network credential
issues.summary: The first handshake request carries an unsalted SipHash digest of the network name and secret in clear text. A captured digest can be replayed to join the network, and a weak secret can be cracked offline, which also yields the traffic keys.
issues.source: Master thesis, section "EasyTier: the handshake leaks a crackable network credential"
